{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure freshness
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check unique values in the 'status' column
status_values = sales_df['status'].unique()

# Check if 'refunded' is the only non-completed state
non_completed = [s for s in status_values if s != 'completed']

# Also check for any other anomalies, like typos
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts().sort_index()

status_values, non_completed, status_counts"}
